name: io.github.divenire990/omp-worker-mcp
title: omp-worker-mcp
description: Hand off coding tasks from ChatGPT, Codex or Claude Code to local Oh My Pi (OMP) workers.

environmentVariables.name: OMP_WORKER_OMP_COMMAND
environmentVariables.description: Path or executable name for the local OMP CLI binary.

environmentVariables.name: OMP_WORKER_ALLOWED_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Optional JSON array of absolute directory paths that delegated job cwd values must resolve inside.
